description: List Product Hunt Stories from the main feed, a verified story category, or the Stories search control. Compact output includes article discovery fields, author URLs, and pagination metadata by default; detailed mode adds extended article and retrieval metadata. Category and query filters are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional Product Hunt Stories category slug such as makers, news, opinions, announcements, how-to, or interviews; mutually exclusive with query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text submitted to the verified Search Stories control on the main Stories page; mutually exclusive with category.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Local maximum number of currently loaded Stories to return; integer from 1 through 25. This is not upstream pagination.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Return additional description, image, section, category details, and retrieval time. Compact output already includes author URLs and pagination metadata. Pass true or false; default false.
